items.entity: finite-element mesh n_x × n_y for cantilever_basic
items.description: Table 3 / Sec. 5.1 give no mesh for cantilever_basic, and the Table 3 names do not match the Table 5 names. 60×30 is only inferable from the configurator default 'mesh 60×30' (Alg. 2) and from GT C = 63.69 equalling the LLM entry for cantilever_60×30 in Table 5. Sec. 4.1 says standard cantilevers come at 'three mesh resolutions (60×30, 120×40)' but lists only two.

ProblemSpec contains L_x, L_y (Eq. 1), but no values are given for this case. A 2:1 rectangle follows only if square elements on the 60×30 mesh are assumed. The 2×1×0.5 3-D cantilever domain (Fig. 9) and the r = 0.2 hole in the Sec. 4.1 example point to normalized units. With square bilinear elements, a point load and r_min in element units, the absolute size leaves C unchanged; a non-2:1 extent would give non-square elements.

V_f is not stated for cantilever_basic (Table 3, Sec. 5.1). Alg. 2's default is 0.5, Sec. 4.1 lists cantilever variants at 0.3/0.4/0.6 as separate problems, and C = 63.69 lies between the vf40 (78.47) and vf60 (53.93) entries in Table 5. So 0.5 is implied but never stated.

items.entity: tip load on the right (free) edge
items.description: Alg. 2 says only 'cantilever → left edge fixed + tip load'; the height of the load on the right edge is not given for this row. The mid-right wording ('downward load at mid-right', 'F_y = −1 at node (nelx, nely/2)', Sec. 4.1) is quoted for cantilever_hole, whereas the classic 99/88-line cantilever loads the bottom-right corner.
readings: x = L_x, y = 0.5·L_y (mid-height of right edge)
x = L_x, y = L_y (top-right corner, mirror image of the bottom-corner case)

items.description: It is not stated whether the tip load is a single-node point load (nearest node, Eq. 2) or a shear spread along the right edge (trapezoidal weights, Eq. 3). A separate 'cantilever_shear (60×30)' benchmark in Table 5 suggests, but does not confirm, a point load here.
readings: uniform shear distributed along the whole right edge (trapezoidal-rule nodal weights)

items.description: 'Tip load' (Alg. 2) has no stated direction; 'downward' appears only in the cantilever_hole prompt (Sec. 1.3/4.1). A vertical load is implied. Reversing its sign changes neither the compliance nor the layout.
No load magnitude is given for this row; the only value in the text is 'F_y = −1' in the Sec. 4.1 cantilever_hole example.
The ProblemSpec has a 'material' field (Sec. 1.3, Fig. 2), but no Young's modulus is given anywhere in the text.
Poisson's ratio is not given anywhere (Sec. 1.3/3.1 mention 'material' only).

items.entity: 2-D analysis assumption (plane stress/strain, thickness, element type)
items.description: Sec. 3.3 never states plane stress vs plane strain, out-of-plane thickness, or element type (bilinear Q4 implied by the structured grid). Plane strain changes the effective Poisson ratio; thickness only scales C.
readings: plane stress, unit thickness, bilinear Q4

items.description: Sec. 3.3 says only that stiffness 'follows the SIMP interpolation [1]'. ρ_min = 1e-3 bounds the design variables (Eq. 5, Sec. 3.2), but at β = 32 the projected densities fall far below that. Whether a modified-SIMP E_min is used, and its value, is not stated.
readings: E = (projected density)^p·E0 with projected density floored at 1e-3

items.entity: continuation controller used for the Table 3 GT/LLM-configured runs
items.description: The Table 3 caption and Sec. 4.4 say both runs use the LLM agent controller with 300 iterations, and C = 63.69 matches the LLM column of Table 5. The Fig. 5 caption says both were solved with the schedule controller at 300 iterations; Table 5 gives 64.46 for that controller, so the two give different designs.
readings: LLM agent controller (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, DNC interface)

items.entity: pre-tail continuation of penalization p, Heaviside β and move limit δ
items.description: Only the 40-iteration tail (p = 4.5, β = 32, r_min = 1.20, δ = 0.05) and p_gate = 3.0 are specified. The LLM agent's per-iteration decisions, observation interval k and prompt are not reported, and its runs are non-deterministic (Sec. 4). The schedule controller's 'pre-computed parameter values' and phase lengths are never listed (Sec. 4.2/3.6), and no starting values are given for the Sec. 3.3 init method.
readings: three-field-style: p linear 1→4.5 over 30 iterations, β doubled every 10 iterations from 1, δ = 0.2
step-wise: p = 1→2→3→4.5, β raised from 1 only after p ≥ 3, δ = 0.2
constant p = 3, β = 1, δ = 0.2 until the tail

items.entity: density-filter radius r_min before the tail, and its units
items.description: r_min = 1.20 is given only for the tail (Sec. 3.3/4.2). The starting/exploration radius (adjusted by the LLM agent, 'tightened late' by the three-field baseline) is missing, as are its units: element widths or the physical units of L_x, L_y.
readings: 1.5 element widths in exploration, 1.2 in tail
2.0 element widths in exploration, 1.2 in tail
1.2 in physical length units (equals element units only if element size = 1)

items.description: Eq. 5 only says w_ej are 'density filter weights within radius r_min'; the kernel and distance measure are not given.
readings: linear cone w = max(0, r_min − centre-to-centre distance)

items.description: H_β is cited to Wang et al. [3] (Sec. 3.3), but the threshold η and the exact projection formula are not given.
readings: exponential projection of Guest et al.

items.entity: iteration budget / termination of the GT run
items.description: Table 3 and Sec. 4.4 give '300 iterations', but it is unclear whether the 40-iteration tail is included. Sec. 5.2 and 6.3 speak of a '300-iteration exploration phase/warm-up', while Fig. 7 puts the LLM exploration at iterations 0–120 and convergence by ~150. The early-exit and stability tests (relative range < 0.005, Sec. 4.3) have no window length.
readings: main loop exits early on convergence (~120–150 iterations), then 40-iteration tail

items.description: Sec. 3.3 says only 'updates ρ via OC with move limit δ'; the damping exponent and the Lagrange-multiplier bisection bounds/tolerance are not given.

items.entity: initial density field of the main loop
items.description: The starting design is not stated; only the tail-only reset to V_f·1 is (Eq. 6). A seed of 42 is cited for all runs (Sec. 4) without saying what it randomizes.
readings: uniform V_f plus small random perturbation (seed 42)
